disposition.target: Ownership Map and rwb-deviation API definition
disposition.change: Publish a service read of open deviations by case; publish the agent-policy read operation and its fields; publish codes and owner roles of R-DEV-05 and R-DEV-06 with package version; set the answer limit and test level.
disposition.note: Deviation estate read, agent-policy read, rule owners, answer limit and test level sit in rwb-deviation and the Ownership Map, not in this story.

disposition.change: Fix the run-start operation on /api/recovery/agent/v1 with its members and refusal codes; read case, parameters and lists via rwb-case, deviations via rwb-deviation, ledger via rwb-source-data, documents via rwb-document, 2 s budget each; publish run events on rwb.agent.events.v1 via outbox.
disposition.note: Screening slice values belong to the rwb-agent contract, not to the rwb-access slice of this story.

disposition.change: Covers column of TC-E1-062-03, 04, 05, 07 and 09 aligned to Test Cases v8 AC3, AC4, AC5, AC7 and AC9.
disposition.note: Five §16 rows now cite the acceptance criteria that Test Cases v8 cites for the same test cases.

disposition.change: Align the test lists of REQ-DVH-001, REQ-DVH-003, REQ-DVH-007 and REQ-ACA-010 in the RTM next version with §18 of this story.
disposition.note: Ruling defers alignment to the next versions of §18 and the RTM; the RTM change is recorded here for the RTM owner.

disposition.change: SCR-43 states now list the specification states and mark empty, loading, error and no access as Not specified in the source documents.
disposition.note: Screen Specifications v1 lacks the four states, so they are recorded as not specified rather than invented.

disposition.change: SCR-47 states now list masked, unmasked and loading, and mark empty, error and no access as Not specified in the source documents.
disposition.note: Loading is added from the specification; empty, error and no access are recorded as not specified.

disposition.change: Add the v1 and v2 change notes, dates and contents to the FSD S8 version history; carry them as Not specified in the source documents (GAP-1834) until then.
disposition.note: The version history belongs to FSD S8; this story has no inherited history table to carry it in.

disposition.change: State the platform population figures NFR-001, NFR-002 and NFR-011 and the two evaluation samples of 200 and 500 cases; assert no module volume; size wave 2 after measuring the shadow run.
disposition.note: No module volume exists in the sources, so the volume statement belongs to the FSD owner, not this story.

disposition.change: State that the agent case read maps to API-P5-002 and its document read to API-P5-003, with API-P5-009 for an extracted-field filter; publish the tool call field names in the AsyncAPI and OpenAPI of rwb-document.
disposition.note: The document-read tool is the screening agent's contract, not an operation of this rwb-access slice.

disposition.change: Fix the DocumentStored payload as documentId, caseId, documentType, source and storedAt; state that the idempotency key is the outbox event ID.
disposition.note: Event payload and idempotency key are defined in the rwb-document AsyncAPI and the P10 contract, not in this story.
